1.web: Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say,
1.asv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,

2.web: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.
2.asv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.

3.web: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.
3.asv: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.

4.web: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.
4.asv: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

5.web: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
5.asv: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

6.web: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up;
6.asv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;

7.web: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.
7.asv: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves, his bosom:

8.web: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of Yahweh be on you. We bless you in Yahweh’s name.”
8.asv: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah.
